revision.round2: supersedes cap_58c0f5d4088c evidence after round-2 gaming-resistance hardening: terminal full-baseline seed + 11 mutable overlays; eight identity-distinct in-process sort iterations with per-rep frozen-digest validation; fresh mount+IPC+net namespaces with a private tmpfs MS_MOVEd over /tmp plus subreaper reap-until-none of candidate-uid processes.
revision.round4: supersedes cap_3432da05c288 after round-4 robustness hardening. (1) CG: whole-tree memory accounting. Peak RSS was resource.getrusage(RUSAGE_CHILDREN).ru_maxrss read inside the intermediate worker.py, which only accounts a worker's direct reaped children, so a double-forked detached sorter helper's memory was charged to nobody and vanished from the receipt. The evaluator now mounts a fresh root-only cgroup2, parks itself in a trusted leaf, delegates +memory, and gives every timed repetition a fresh leaf that the worker joins as its first preexec action (while still root, before the mount ns is unshared); after the whole candidate-uid tree is reaped the parent reads the leaf's kernel-owned monotone memory.peak (bytes) and drains the leaf. worker.py no longer computes or reports RSS. The demoted uid can never write the root-owned cgroup control files. (2) EST/RSS recalibration: A-A, controls, and the peak-RSS cap were remeasured under the shipped 8-variant bench + new cgroup harness and refrozen. The whole-tree peak (Python worker glue + benchmark binary + any sorter threads in the leaf) is a larger, harness-consistent scale than the prior ru_maxrss binary-only figure; peakRssMaxKiB re-frozen at 23040 KiB (observed baseline 13344/14172 and improved 20904-21896 across both splits; ~5% over the improved worst case, still well under a whole-database-in-memory candidate's >30 MiB). Round-2 per-rep NS isolation + subreaper reaping and the identity/structurally-distinct 8-variant bench are unchanged.

measurement.rssSource: per-repetition trusted cgroup2 leaf memory.peak over the whole candidate-uid tree (bytes), read after full-tree reap; replaces RUSAGE_CHILDREN ru_maxrss
measurement.harness: the root evaluator times each repetition externally with monotonic_ns around a demoted out-of-process worker; candidate-linked code never supplies elapsed time; every repetition gets a fresh writable state directory in fresh mount+IPC+net namespaces and a fresh root-only cgroup leaf joined before the privilege drop, with subreaper reap-until-none of candidate-uid processes after every repetition; whole-tree peak memory is read from the leaf's kernel-owned memory.peak; the benchmark binary is sealed root-owned read-only and hash-verified after all repetitions; the frozen database is hash-verified before and after; result digests are validated in the trusted parent against oracles sealed outside the candidate-readable workspace; the fastest-three-of-seven scalarizer keeps shared-host interference from inflating scored latency while remaining impossible for candidate-controlled code to deflate

terminalSeal.attestation: No optimizer pilot, mutation/headroom run, seed-optimizer session, queryable optimizer corpus write, or search-visible state was used; terminal identities, fixtures, scores, and feedback stayed inside capsules/sqlite-speedtest1 and trusted admission evidence.
